notes: GAAP city; same choices as FY2023. Governmental lines from Total Governmental Funds column (p6): 1,302,915 + 1,748,623 - 1,379,594 + 515,750 - 515,750 = 1,671,944. Business-type from proprietary Total column (p9): 1,534,667 + 437,384 - 360,372 = 1,611,679 (no transfers; operating + nonoperating lines added, no single printed total). ending_cash = governmental funds balance sheet cash lines (claim on cash 1,289,471 + restricted 218,148 + county treasurer 15,106, p5); restricted CDs 10,000 as ending_investments; no beginning cash printed. Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position (pp1-2); Total column total assets is 1 higher than its parts (rounding; report_discrepancies). Water 'Other revenue' 114,867 is counted in Water charges for services on the Statement of Activities, so charges for services/fees. Grant income 14,001 has no grantor printed: category other, detail Grants. 'Equipment sinking fund' 6 is a function line with no function printed (other). Capital outlay prints no function, labelled 'Capital Outlay'. Detail: the only supplementary schedules are the all-funds cash-basis budgetary comparison (pp12-13) and the nonmajor permanent-funds combining statement (p14), so detail is one line per fund column of the governmental funds statement (p6) and proprietary funds statement (p9), plus the Orton Estate column of p14 (Lesiak Estate no activity); the all-funds budget schedule lines are not recorded.
